question: Should the four hosted records name their self-hosted counterpart by record id, as dev-services/n8n-cloud -> dev-services/n8n-community-edition, dev-services/temporal-cloud -> dev-services/temporal-server, dev-services/inngest -> dev-services/inngest-server and dev-services/cron-job-org -> dev-services/cron-job-org-chronos?
why: each hosted record names its self-hosted option last in tooling, by product and not by record id, so the two records of one vendor are not tied together from the hosted side; the new self-hosted records name the hosted record first in chaining and notes
